Thanks again for taking the time this morning, James — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Improve product description generation quality for long-tail SKUs while keeping per-token cost under $0.0009.

Model recommendations from our side (based on the prompts and sample outputs you shared):
1) redwood-llm-phi-13B-quant (recommended start) — best balance of quality/cost for short-to-medium prompts
2) redwood-llm-phi-70B-ht (fallback for top-tier SKUs where higher fidelity needed)

What I attached: benchmark highlights (compact PDF), the prompt sets we used (prompt-sets-retailco-v1.jsonl), and an initial diff CSV comparing outputs between your current model and redwood-llm-phi-13B-quant.

Proposed next steps:
- You: Confirm which set of 200 dev prompts you want us to prioritize for the initial eval (I highlighted recommended batch A in the prompt file).
- Us: Run a 3k-token evaluation across the prioritized prompts, generate automated metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore), and synthetic QA checks; share the evaluation report within 48 hours.
- Follow-up: 30-minute sync next Wed to review metrics and decide whether to pin or rollout a new variant.

If you have any immediate concerns about regression after your recent model update, flag them here and we can expedite an investigation (we can also pin the previous serving version while we run diffs).

Best,
